source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

chapter_binding.tsw_alignment_reason: Pinned 2:28 starts with the Father clause placed in TSW 2:27; compare 2:27–28 together. Public labels are unchanged.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the speaker's localized polemical claim without extending it to Jews generally.
key_decisions.before: I know your affliction and your poverty (but you are rich), and the slander of people who say that they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
key_decisions.after: I know your suffering and poverty—but you are rich—and the slander from those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I know your affliction and your poverty (but you are rich), and the slander of those who say that they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the named witness, actual killing and repeated where clauses.
key_decisions.before: I know where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. Yet you hold firmly my name, and you did not deny my faith even in the days of Antipas my faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
key_decisions.after: I know where you live, where Satan's throne is. You hold firmly to my name and did not deny faith in me even in the days of Antipas, my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan lives.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I know where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. Yet you hold fast my name, and you did not deny my faith even in the days of Antipas my faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the woman's specific gender and claimed role, both acts and slavery vocabulary.
key_decisions.before: But I have this against you, that you tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess and is teaching and deceiving my servants to practice sexual immorality and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
key_decisions.after: But I have this against you: you tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet and teaches and leads my slaves astray to commit sexual immorality and eat food sacrificed to idols.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But I have this against you, that you tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess and is teaching and deceiving my servants to practice sexual immorality and to eat food sacrificed to idols.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the bed metaphor without silently adding sick and follows her works rather than their works.
key_decisions.before: Look, I will throw her onto a sickbed, and people who commit adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent of her works,
key_decisions.after: Look, I am throwing her onto a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great suffering, unless they repent of her works.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Behold, I will throw her onto a sickbed, and those who commit adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent of her works,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the harsh threat and anatomical image; alternatives are explained in notes.
key_decisions.before: and I will strike her children dead. And all the churches will know that I am the one who searches mind and heart, and I will give to each of you according to your works.
key_decisions.after: I will kill her children with death. Then all the churches will know that I am the one who searches kidneys and hearts, and I will give each of you according to your works.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and I will strike her children dead. And all the churches will know that I am the one who searches mind and heart, and I will give to each of you according to your works.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the shepherding verb and violent comparison rather than smoothing it into a single ruling term.
key_decisions.before: and he will rule them with a rod of iron, as when earthen pots are broken in pieces, even as I myself have received authority from my Father.
key_decisions.after: and that person will shepherd them with an iron rod, as clay vessels are shattered,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and he will rule them with a rod of iron, as when earthen pots are broken in pieces, even as I myself have received authority from my Father.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the Father's prior gift and the unnamed star's promise at the source boundary.
key_decisions.before: And I will give him the morning star.
key_decisions.after: just as I too have received from my Father. And I will give that person the morning star.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I will give him the morning star.
